name: Dark Thaumaturgical Rituals — 2 Intermediate — Felis Negrum

system.description: Burning cat materials over blood-inscribed glass transforms the caster or, after winning a Mental Challenge, an unwilling subject into a black cat with altered Physical Traits, retaining Social and Mental Traits, Health Levels, Disciplines and Blood Pool, while becoming immune to Dominate and Presence but vulnerable to Animalism.
